explanation: Brother of Moses and high priest in Israel, chosen by God to serve in the priesthood.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel, selected by God to serve in the tabernacle and later the temple as assistants to the priests.
A temporary sanctuary and meeting place between God and his people, where sacrifices and ceremonies were performed.
The eldest son of Levi, and one of the three main families among the Levites.
The second son of Levi, and one of the three main families among the Levites.
The third son of Levi, and one of the three main families among the Levites.
The supreme leader of the priesthood, responsible for performing important ritual actions and sacrifices.
The top cover of the Ark of the Covenant, where God's presence was to rest and where the high priest was to offer the atonement sacrifice.
